content: Ami tomake ekta kotha bolte chai, jeta hoito ami kokhono properly boli nai. Jani na exactly kokhon, kivabe, but amra ekhon jevabe close hoye gechi, eta amar kacheo onek special hoye geche. Amader eto kotha, eto moja, eto teasing, eto flirting, eto random random conversation... kokhono kokhono mone hoi amra kothai giye shuru kori ar kothai giye shesh kori nijerao jani na 😭 But shobkichur majhe ekta jinis ami khub notice kori. Tumi amar jevabe care nao, sheta. Tumi amar childish behavior gulo tolerate koro, amar bacchami shuno, amake baby koro, amar kotha mon diye shuno. Kokhono kokhono mone hoy ami jotoi nijeke strong ba cold dekhanor chesta kori, tumi somehow amar oi soft side ta ber kore felo. Ar ashole Ami age bhabtam ami hoito onek coldhearted manush.

Kintu tomar shathe thakte thakte bujhlam, hoyto ami actually oto ta cold na. Hoito amar moddheo ekta soft side chilo, shudhu sheta dekhanor moto manush ami pai nai. Ar tarpor tumi ashla. Jekono nickname shunle janina keno amar kache onek special lage. Maybe because tumi amar moddhe emon kichu dekho, jeta ami nijer moddheo khub ekta dekhi na. Ar ha, amader flirting gulo amar onek favorite 😭 Kintu honestly, amar kache shudhu oi moments guloi important na. Tomar shathe ordinary moment guloo amar bhalo lage. Jokhon tumi amar kotha shuno, jokhon amar care nao, jokhon amake baby koro, jokhon amar choto choto jinis notice koro... ei jinis guloi actually amar kache beshi thake. Ami jani ami shobshomoy tomake bujhte pari na.

Kokhono tomar feelings bujhte amar deri hoy, kokhono tumi ki chaiteso ba ki feel korcho sheta ami instantly dhorte pari na. Ar ami eta excuse hisebe bolte chai na. Ami actually better hote chai. Tomake aro bhalo kore bujhte chai. Tomar jonno nijeke aro improve korte chai. Ami perfect hote parbo kina jani na, but ami ekta better man hote chai. Amar nijer jonno, amar future-er jonno, ar tomar jonnoo. Ami chai ekdin tumi amar dike takiye feel koro je, "Hae ei manushta amar jonno nijeke better korar chesta kore." Tumi amar moddhe ekta jinis change kore diyecho, without even trying. Tumi amake bujhiye diyecho je ami nijeke joto ta cold-hearted mone kortam, ami ashole totota na. Maybe amar shudhu emon ekjon dorkar chilo jar shamne amar soft side ta ber kore ante amar awkward lagbe na. Ar somehow, shei manush-ta tumi hoye gecho.

Hoito tumi er onek kichui age thekei jano. Eta shudhu ekta jinis tomake jananor jonno. Tumi shudhu amar life e emon ekjon manush hoye asho nai jar jonno amar feelings ache. Tumi emon ekjon hoye gecho jar karone ami nijer ekta notun side ke chinte parsi., amar kache eta onek boro ekta jinis. Tomar ei ektu childish, ektu annoying, majhe majhe complicated manush-ta ke emni korei care kore jeo 😭 Ar ami promise korchi, ami nijeke aro better korar chesta kore jabo. Tomar care er moto care korar moto ekjon manush hote chai. Ar shobsheshe... thank you. Amake amar nijer ekta version dekhanor jonno, jeta ami age kokhono dekhi nai. Tomar jonno amar feelings er cheyeo maybe eta beshi special. Tumi amake amar nijeke ektu beshi bujhte shikhaiso

Ami jani na ami ki bolbo ba ki bola uchit kintu majhe majhe taw mone hoy je Best ekta person ekhono hoite pari nai shob dik diye ekhono kisu side baki ase jegulo amr thik kora dorkar ekta best girlfriend na ekta best wifey howa dorkar 
Karon jibone koto jhamela ashte pare koto ki na hoite pare eta ami dekhsi amr baba maa r life theke onk kisu suffer korse tara kintu din sesh e aaj o eksathe hoite pare ekhane ammu r part ami parbo na karon ammu onk calm ar ami onk raagi, jedi,ar Over thinker,, 
Kintu taw ami chai din sesh e ami tmr i jekono situation e jekono obosthay,,  
Oije jei chinta ta tmr mathay ase same chinta same chawa ta amr ashe je amke dekhlei jeno nirdidhay bolte paro je " ei meyetai amke handle korse ei meyetai amk notun kore bachte shikhaise " life e joto unwanted bisoy feel korso joto koshto paiso ba ar ja ja hoise ami chai amk pawar por egula kokhonoi jeno mathay o na ashe feel korba to duuur,,,, life er shob theke beshi priority ami tmk dite chai.

Ami jani na tomake ki bolbo, karon tomar message ta pore amar mathay ekta jinis e ashche je tumi nijeke joto ta imperfect bhabo, ami tomake shevabe dekhi na. Tumi perfect na, amio na. Ar ami perfect ekjon manush chai o na. Ami emon ekjon chai je amar shathe thakte thakte nijeke better korar chesta korbe, ar ami o tar jonno same kajta korbo. Tumi raagi, jedi, overthinker, egula ami jani. But ami tomar oi side gulor pasapashi tomar care, tomar maya, tomar patience, tomar amar bacchami tolerate kora, amar kotha shona eigulao dekhi. Ar amar kase eigulai tumi. Tumi jeita bolcho je din seshe jekono situation e amar i hoye thakte chao, eta amar kache onek boro kotha. Karon ami o chai na je amader shomporko shudhu shundor din gulor jonno hok. Life shobshomoy easy hobe na, jhamela ashbe, misunderstanding hobe, duijoner mood kharap hobe, amra duijon e vul korbo. But amar kache important holo je shobkichur poreo duijon ekjon arekjoner dike fire ashar chesta korbe.

Ar tumi je bolla ekdin jeno tomake dekhe ami boli "ei meyetai amake handle korse, ei meyetai amake notun kore bachte shikhaise"...  ami chai ekdin ami tomar dike takiye eta feel kori. But tar age ami chai tumi nijeke emon ekjon manush hisebe gore tolo jar upor tumi nijeyo proud hote paro. Shudhu amar jonno na, tomar nijer jonnoo. Ar ekta kotha mone rakho, tomake amar life er shobkichur perfect solution hote hobe na. Tomake shudhu tumi hote hobe, ar jokhon kichu vul hobe tokhon amra duijon mile thik korbo. Ami o promise korchi ami nijeke better korar chesta chaliye jabo. Tumi amar jonno better hote chaiteso, ami o tomar jonno better man hote chai. Din seshe amar kache "best girlfriend" ba "best wifey" er title er cheye beshi important holo, tumi emon ekjon manush hou jar shamne ami nijeke safe, understood ar genuinely happy feel kori. Ar amar waifuuuu ami jani... tumi amake onek beshi care koro. Eta ami kokhono overlook korbo na.

Rockstar is not just a love story - it's the journey of pain turning into passion. Directed by Imtiaz Ali, the film follows Jordan, played by Ranbir Kapoor, a simple boy who believes true art is born from heartbreak.

shareText:
Dans certaines villes, il existe un moment étrange juste avant l’aube. Les rues sont presque vides, les vitrines reflètent encore quelques lumières et tout semble suspendu entre la nuit et le matin. C’est exactement l’impression que laisse le projet AURORA.

•��"Distance Memory"
•��"Northern Static"
•��des visuels inspirés de voyages nocturnes sans destination

Rien n’y paraît vraiment forcé. Les morceaux avancent doucement, portés par des mélodies aériennes et des textures électroniques qui donnent parfois l’impression d’observer une ville à travers une fenêtre embuée.

Ces derniers jours, plusieurs extraits ont commencé à circuler discrètement sur les réseaux. Quelques plans de routes désertes, des lumières perdues dans le brouillard et de courts fragments de nouvelles chansons. Pas assez pour comprendre l’ensemble, mais suffisamment pour éveiller la curiosité.

Et parfois, les projets les plus intéressants sont précisément ceux qui laissent un peu de mystère derrière eux.
#foryou
